articles.title: Denise Nakamura, 96, Volunteer Firefighter
articles.deck: Friends remember Denise Nakamura for the many years of service to Lower Millrace.
body: Denise Nakamura died in December at home on Keystone Terrace, at the age of 96.

Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Lower Millrace. Born in Lower Millrace in the years after the war, Denise Nakamura spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Stonebridge Trail Crew in his or her name.
